compiled_state.title: As a sprint orchestrator, I want a post-batch visual-evaluator dispatch at Opus 4.7 with a token-budget guard and hard-stop ceiling, so post-batch reviews include pixel-observable signal without unbounded cost
compiled_state.author: Test

comments.body:
## Description

**What**: Add a sprint step that dispatches the visual-evaluator at Opus 4.7 for a post-batch review pass, guarded by a soft-warn + hard-stop token budget.

**Scope**:
- IN: Sprint step after VISUAL_CMD dispatches evaluator at Opus 4.7
- IN: Token-budget guard: soft-warn at visual_evaluator.post_batch_token_budget (default 50000); hard-stop at 3× soft threshold → skip remainder of sprint
- IN: Degradation path when 5th reviewer skipped (arbitration falls back to 4-reviewer committee)
- OUT: 5th reviewer definition (draft-5b)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, sprint step after VISUAL_CMD dispatches visual-evaluator at Opus 4.7 for post-batch pass
  <- Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, soft-warn fires when projected tokens exceed visual_evaluator.post_batch_token_budget (default 50000); logs degradation_type=visual_eval_post_batch_nearing_budget
  <- Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, hard-stop fires at 3× soft threshold → dispatch SKIPPED for remainder of sprint; emits degradation_type=visual_eval_post_batch_skipped_budget_exceeded; ticket annotated; arbitration falls back to 4-reviewer committee
  <- Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue. Escalate only when genuinely blocked. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
comments.author: Test
